notes: Upgrades the existing Brand Calendar route rather than creating a parallel scheduler.
Uses Kairo's approved product/DESIGN.md baseline with UI UX Pro Max as the primary workflow/accessibility skill and ui-review as the evidence review skill.
Adds visual month orientation and URL-state Brand/Campaign/channel/status filters while preserving truthful deterministic publish command state.
Existing retry/cancel actions remain the only publish-command mutations in this slice; there is no drag-drop mutation or autonomous scheduling.
Plan My Week, new social providers, OAuth changes, analytics ingestion, deployment and real publication are outside scope.

approvals.rationale: Owner prioritized roadmap items through #13, requested continuous implementation under standing pre-approval, required all approved relevant skills from this point forward, and said Go to continue after VS-31.
Approved PRD FR-14 already requires a simple calendar with Brand/Campaign/channel/status filtering and scheduling visibility; the slice does not expand autonomous publishing policy.
Standing implementation pre-approval covers code, tests, CI fixes, UI review and PR preparation for the priority roadmap; exact-SHA certification/merge/release/production gates remain separate.
Requires deterministic evidence and explicit approval bound to the final exact candidate SHA.
Separate exact-SHA release approval is required.
Separate exact-SHA production-enable approval is required.

postRelease.expectedOutcome: Users can understand and filter planned/published content quickly from a simple visual calendar without losing truthful publication state or accessibility.
